currentUserGoal: Continue the ecosystem redesign by teaching the player what the first Tiny Sprinkler does after it has been purchased.
workCompleted: Added a shared first-automation objective state with locked, gather, ready, first-cycle, sustain, dry, and paused stages.
Changed the Living Ledger strip from a generic active indicator into a guided sequence: gather 14 RT, buy the sprinkler, watch the first spray, then keep its Dew reserve supplied.
Made a sub-one-Dew reserve produce an explicit dry-sprinkler instruction instead of relying on fractional natural Dew production to report a pause.
Synchronized the Phaser copy, semantic readable state, and redesign debug snapshot through the same objective resolver.
Added a one-time CARE ONLINE celebration at the first completed Caretaker water impact, using existing pooled text, water, impact, audio, and tween objects.
Prevented Cultivator-mode cycles from incorrectly celebrating Care production.
Documented the guided first-cycle contract and added deterministic transition coverage.
verificationRun: npm run check passed: ESLint, 121 Vitest tests across 17 files, strict TypeScript, and the Vite production build.
The focused EcosystemSystem suite passed 16 tests, including locked to gather to ready to firstCycle to sustain to dry objective transitions.

At 1280x720 on the actual redesign route, Run 2 began in gather, reached ready after sixteen accepted touches, entered firstCycle after the 14 RT purchase, and reached sustain after the first production cycle.
The live semantic copy reported the first Dew-to-Moisture-and-Care cycle, then changed to Care online with a 22.3 Dew reserve and continued cycle progress.
Tiny Sprinkler produced 0.109 Care per second during the verified sustain state.
Browser diagnostics contained no errors or warnings.
The in-app browser remained fixed at 1280x720, so a true 390x844 pass was not available for this slice.
